description: The FAO map describes land and water scarcity pressures on rainfed and irrigated agricultural systems. The cited provider is FAO. Access starts from the cited provider page or document; no underlying files were retrieved. Listed formats are WMS. The inspected metadata names the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licence. The public information is free to read; underlying resource charges remain unverified. Documentation does not establish completeness, calibration quality or suitability for a particular simulation. For infrastructure simulation, it can inform irrigation-demand or agricultural water-management scenarios.
